rules.title: The PowerShell parser rejected the source.
rules.predicate: Parser.ParseInput returned at least one parse error.

rules.title: The source contains a parser-sensitive directive candidate.
rules.predicate: The lexical guard found using, configuration or #requires after accounting for backticks. The AST parser does not receive this source.

rules.title: Avoid direct Invoke-Expression evaluation.
rules.predicate: A CommandAst literal name is Invoke-Expression, iex, or Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility\Invoke-Expression, ignoring case.

rules.title: A catch clause must contain a statement or a trap.
rules.predicate: A native CatchClauseAst has no body statements or traps.

rules.title: Review this literal error-suppression argument.
rules.predicate: A CommandAst uses an explicit -ErrorAction with the literal SilentlyContinue or Ignore.

rules.title: Review this explicit global variable reference.
